audience.text: Developers building Node.js applications that require PDF processing capabilities without external runtime dependencies.

capabilities.text: Parses classic cross-reference tables and streams, object streams, and all stream filters; recovers damaged files and reports what was repaired and lost.
capabilities.title: PDF Parsing and Repair

capabilities.text: Access and edit every page through doc.Pages with all five boundary boxes, rotation, resources, and content; manipulate the page set with AddPage, InsertPage, RemovePage, Reorder, Split, ExtractPages, Append, and Document.Merge.
capabilities.title: Page Manipulation

capabilities.text: Stamp text with AddText and AddTextBlock using the 12 Standard-14 Latin fonts or embedded TrueType/OpenType/WOFF/WOFF2 fonts, with optional complex-text shaping for bidi, Arabic, and OpenType GSUB/GPOS scripts.
capabilities.title: Text Authoring and Styling

capabilities.text: Draw vector graphics with page.Graphics() (lines, shapes, gradients, tiling patterns) and embed raster images (JPEG, PNG, BMP, TIFF) or vector SVG assets with page.AddSVGObject.
capabilities.title: Vector Graphics and Images

capabilities.text: Create, fill, and style AcroForm fields, regenerate appearance streams, and round-trip field data through FDF/XFDF import and export; enumerate and edit 16 annotation subtypes.
capabilities.title: Forms and Annotations

capabilities.text: Read and author tagged-PDF structure with GetStructTree, AutoTag, CreateStructTree, and StructElement APIs; validate against PDF/UA and convert to PDF/UA.
capabilities.title: Tagged PDF and Accessibility

capabilities.text: Open encrypted PDFs with standard and public-key encryption; write encrypted output; validate and convert to PDF/A and PDF/X; redact content; sanitize hidden data; and digitally sign with PAdES/B-LT/B-LTA.
capabilities.title: Security and Compliance

capabilities.text: Render pages to SVG or raster images (PNG/JPEG/TIFF/BMP/GIF) with a pure-TypeScript software rasterizer; export documents to reflowable or fixed-layout HTML, Markdown, DOCX, or EPUB.
capabilities.title: Export and Rendering

limitations.text: Resource limits reduce known amplification but do not make a hostile file safe; CPU time is not bounded and combined memory limits are separate.
Damaged-file recovery is partial; objects stored inside an /ObjStm that are damaged are lost, and a scan cannot distinguish live from freed objects.
SVG rendering is preview-grade; text is positioned <text> styled by font family/weight, and exact glyph shapes depend on the viewer's fonts.
Complex-text shaping applies generic OpenType GSUB/GPOS only; there are no script-specific reordering engines for Indic, SEA, or Khmer.
DOCX import is a documented subset, not a Word layout engine; legacy .doc is out of scope, and headers, footers, footnotes, and revision tracking are not exported.
Digital signing is single-pass; incremental-append requires the in-memory model unchanged since Open; any mutation switches signing to a full rewrite.

problems_solved.text: Enables parsing, editing, and rendering of PDF documents entirely in TypeScript with no external runtime dependencies.
Supports resource-bounded opening of untrusted PDFs to prevent memory exhaustion through LoadLimits.
Provides redaction, sanitization, and optimization workflows to remove hidden data and shrink file size.
Enables digital signing with PAdES/B-LT/B-LTA support, timestamps, and LTV validation data.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PDF FOSS for TypeScript is a free, open-source, zero-dependency TypeScript library for reading, manipulating, and writing PDF files in Node.js.

uncertainties: The library's handling of /User in optional-content configurations is not evaluated, since it names a person or organization and this library has no viewer identity.
XMP writes are not type-checked against predefined schemas; SetXmpValue accepts values that may not conform to their schema types.
The bundled fonts add ~3.1 MB to the library; subsetting the bundled faces to shrink this footprint is future work.
SVG <image> hrefs that are not data URIs are never fetched; the library never fetches an href itself and takes no dependency.
The HTML renderer does not draw <iframe> or <math> content, and <object>, <video>, <audio>, and <canvas> children render only as fallback content.

workflows.name: Open and Edit PDF
workflows.text: Open a PDF with Document.Open, edit pages, metadata, and form fields, then save with Document.Save.

workflows.name: Redact Content
workflows.text: Mark regions for redaction with Page.AddRedact or Page.MarkRedactText, then apply with Page.ApplyRedactions to permanently remove content.

workflows.name: Render to Image
workflows.text: Render a page to PNG, JPEG, TIFF, BMP, or GIF using Page.ToImage with configurable DPI, format, and mode.

workflows.name: Export to Other Formats
workflows.text: Export a document to HTML, Markdown, DOCX, EPUB, or SVG using Document.ToHtml, Document.ToMarkdown, Document.ToDocx, Document.ToEpub, or Page.ToSvg.

workflows.name: Validate and Convert Standards
workflows.text: Validate against PDF/A, PDF/X, or PDF/UA standards with Document.ValidatePdfA, Document.ValidatePdfX, or Document.ValidatePdfUa, and remediate with Document.ConvertToPdfA, Document.ConvertToPdfX, or Document.ConvertToPdfUa.

workflows.name: Sign Document
workflows.text: Add a digital signature with Document.Sign or Document.Certify using PEM, PKCS#12, or external signer callbacks, optionally with timestamps and LTV data.
